mapper.insert: INSERT INTO construction ( construction_id, user_id, user_name, construction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{constructionId}, #{userID}, #{userName}, #{constructionName}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}, #{zipCode}, #{mail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO construction ( construction_id, user_id, user_name, construction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail ) VALUES
( #{item.constructionId}, #{item.userID}, #{item.userName}, #{item.constructionName}, #{item.address}, #{item.phoneNumber}, #{item.zipCode}, #{item.mail} )
mapper.select: SELECT C.construction_id AS constructionId, C.user_id AS userID, C.user_name AS userName, C.construction_name AS constructionName, C.address, C.phone_number AS phoneNumber, C.zip_code AS zipCode, C.mail, C.created_at AS createdAt, C.updated_at AS updatedAt, f.uuid AS fileUuId, f.construction_id AS fileConstructionId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_path AS filePath, f.create_time AS fileCreateTime FROM ( SELECT construction_id, user_id, user_name, construction_name, address, phone_number, zip_code, mail, created_at, updated_at FROM construction ORDER BY construction_name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) c LEFT JOIN files f ON c.construction_id = f.construction_id ORDER BY c.construction_name;

SELECT c.construction_id AS constructionId, c.user_id AS userID, c.user_name AS userName, c.construction_name AS constructionName, c.address, c.phone_number AS phoneNumber, c.zip_code AS zipCode, c.mail, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, f.uuid AS fileUuId, f.construction_id AS fileConstructionId, f.file_name AS fileName, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_path AS filePath, f.create_time AS fileCreateTime FROM construction c LEFT JOIN files f ON c.construction_id = f.construction_id WHERE c.construction_id = #{constructionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE construction SET user_id = #{userID}, user_name = #{userName}, construction_name = #{constructionName}, address = #{address}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, mail = #{mail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE construction_id = #{constructionId} AND updated_at = #{updatedAt}
